Current Rapid plan page sells one-time list prices of $145 / $209 / $356 / $463 for 25K / 50K / 100K / 150K. These are the regular, pre-coupon prices from the page's embedded plan data ("priceCents":14500 / 20900 / 35600 / 46300; the 25K/50K JSON-LD offers read "145.00" / "209.00"), first filled in the 2026-10-14 recapture (which replaced the old null placeholders) and found unchanged on the live page 2026-10-20. Evaluation uses EOD trailing drawdown; the Sim Funded stage uses intraday trailing drawdown and the floor locks at +$100 after the buffer is secured.
The evaluation target is 6% (the official rules table gives $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 by size), with 2 minimum trading days and a 50% evaluation-only consistency rule.

The funded stage has no daily loss limit or consistency rule, a 90/10 split, a $500 minimum payout, and a required buffer of $1,100 / $2,100 / $3,100 / $4,600 by size. The first request is not a fixed day count because the buffer must be cleared.
The firm-wide restricted-country article lists Russia. A trader located in Russia cannot purchase a new account.

Current Builder page says one-time payment with no renewals and $0 activation fee. Stored list prices of $105 / $153 for 25K / 50K come from the page's embedded plan data ("priceCents":10500 / 15300, regular price before the CLUB coupon). They were first filled in the 2026-10-14 recapture and found unchanged on the live page 2026-10-20. The visible promotional starting figures are not used. The embedded data also lists 100K ("priceCents":28200) and 150K ("priceCents":39800) tiers, which are not stored yet because their rules were not captured.

Builder evaluation targets are $1,500 on 25K and $3,000 on 50K (6%); maximum EOD trailing loss is $1,000 and $2,000 by size, with a $1,000 soft pause on 50K, 1 minimum trading day, and no evaluation consistency rule.

Sim Funded Builder applies a 50% consistency rule at payout, requires 2 qualifying days per cycle, clears a $1,100 or $2,100 buffer, and caps payouts at $1,000 or $2,000. The cadence is every 48 hours, represented as on-demand because the schema has no 48-hour enum.
After 5 approved simulated payouts, MFFU describes a live transition with daily payouts, an 80/20 split, and no live consistency rule; the live account has different limits.
